### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the streamed tool-call indexing change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes the Ollama adaptor’s streamed tool-call indexing so OpenAI-compatible clients keep separate calls instead of merging them. **Changes:** - Assigns sequential tool-call indexes using a running offset across stream chunks. - Uses offset zero for non-streaming responses. - Adds a regression test verifying indexes 0, 1, and 2 across multiple chunks. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `core/​relay/​adaptor/​ollama/​main.go` | Assigns tool-call indexes and tracks the offset throughout each stream. | | `core/​relay/​adaptor/​ollama/​main_test.go` | Tests distinct indexes for calls within and across streamed chunks. |
Review effort: Balanced
